style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white, gray and dark cave tones, only key objects red. Northern Thailand, 2018. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: logos, badges, insignia or emblems of real companies, militaries or agencies, marks or lettering on equipment, readable text or numbers, detailed national flags, blood, faces resembling real people
